def no_todo(ctx):
    return [f"X1 {f}: contains TODO" for f in ctx.files if f.endswith(".py") and "TODO" in (ctx.root / f).read_text()]


RULES = [RuleGroup({"X1": "No TODO."}, no_todo)]
